One row per system of the base game: what state AmiWind has it in, which reference decides how it should behave, where the proof is, and which work items and register entries carry the rest. The states are taken from the work lists and the bug register; a row is marked done only when it names a proof.

**7 of 49 systems done**, 39 partial, 3 missing.

| Area | Done | Partial | Missing | Systems |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| World and interiors | 3 | 5 | 2 | 10 |
| Actors and behaviour | 0 | 6 | 0 | 6 |
| The player | 1 | 6 | 0 | 7 |
| Combat, death and the law | 1 | 3 | 0 | 4 |
| Magic | 0 | 4 | 1 | 5 |
| Items, containers and trade | 0 | 5 | 0 | 5 |
| Dialogue, voices, journal and factions | 0 | 4 | 0 | 4 |
| MWScript | 1 | 2 | 0 | 3 |
| Sound, music and the interface | 1 | 4 | 0 | 5 |
| **All** | **7** | **39** | **3** | **49** |

A row counts the system, not its size: a done row can be small and a missing one large. The references are OpenMW 0.51 for behaviour (read for the rules, nothing copied) and the pages of the UESP mirror for the original's numbers.

## Measured: MWScript

tools/mwscript/functions.py (the compiler's own table, counted in the builder container on 9 November 2026) and the builder's script measurement (docs/MWSCRIPT_BYTECODE.md).

| | Count |
| --- | ---: |
| Functions and instructions in the compiler's table | 504 |
| Carried out by the interpreter and the host | 460 (91.3 %) |
| Distinct functions the game's scripts use (23 October 2026, over the three masters) | 251 |
| Of those, carried out | used: pending |
| Scripts in the three masters | 1,207 |
| Scripts that compile | 1,207 |
| Scripts that run whole (9 November 2026, v0.0.63; 9 more are carried by the game's own code) | 605 (50.1 %) |

used_and_carried_out is pending: the builder's script report does not record the used functions per build, so the overlap of the 251 used with the 460 carried out needs one run of python3 -m mwscript.measure on the game data in the builder container (MWSCRIPT-MORE-57). By master: Morrowind.esm 616 scripts = 518 run, 9 carried by the game's own code, 1 only in an add-on world, 88 that nothing in the original names or starts, so every Vvardenfell script the original uses runs; Tribunal.esm 255 = 42 run in Vvardenfell, 8 lack a function, 186 wait for Mournhold, 19 not used; Bloodmoon.esm 336 = 45 run, 20 lack a function, 245 wait for Solstheim, 26 not used.
